target.title: fix(mcp-http): bound foreign response text() reads to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

In `src/agents/mcp-http-fetch.ts`, the `ensureGlobalFetchResponse` fallback path calls `response.text()` with no size limit. This path is hit when an MCP HTTP fetch returns a foreign Response (body=null, custom .text() method) — for example, undici-origin responses that have been consumed upstream. An oversized error/auth body from a hostile or misconfigured MCP server can exhaust memory.

## Root Cause

`ensureGlobalFetchResponse` is called when `buildManagedMcpResponse` receives a response with `body == null`. The function calls `response.text()` unconditionally — no Content-Length pre-check, no post-read truncation.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a 16 MiB bound (matching the codebase precedent: `OPENROUTER_MODELS_BODY_MAX_BYTES`, `APNS_RELAY_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES`, #97551):

- **Content-Length pre-check**: if the declared size exceeds 16 MiB, return 502 `Response Too Large` without reading the body
- **Post-read truncation**: bodies without Content-Length (or under-declared) are truncated to 16 MiB after reading
- **Under-cap pass-through**: bodies ≤ 16 MiB pass through unchanged

## Changes

- `src/agents/mcp-http-fetch.ts`: +16/-1 lines — add `MCP_HTTP_MAX_RESPONSE_BODY_BYTES = 16 MiB` constant; Content-Length pre-check + post-read truncation in `ensureGlobalFetchResponse`
- `src/agents/mcp-http-fetch.test.ts`: +63 lines — new test with 3 sub-scenarios

## Evidence

### Unit tests (11/11)

```
 ✓ scopes TLS overrides to the MCP resource origin
 ✓ uses configured env proxy for ordinary MCP HTTP requests
 ✓ preserves bodyless HTTP 204 responses
 ✓ preserves bodyless HTTP 205 responses
 ✓ preserves bodyless HTTP 304 responses
 ✓ keeps same-origin TLS overrides ahead of configured env proxy
 ✓ uses configured env proxy for redirected targets after a NO_PROXY first hop
 ✓ removes static Authorization headers for OAuth-backed runtime requests
 ✓ adds MCP headers only to same-origin OAuth requests
 ✓ returns fetch responses compatible with MCP SDK OAuth error parsing
 ✓ bounds oversized text-only foreign response bodies at 16 MiB  ← NEW
```

### Real behavior proof

```
$ node --import tsx scripts/proof-mcp-http-bounded-text.mjs
============================================================
MCP HTTP Fetch — Bounded Text Proof
============================================================
Node:      v22.22.0
Platform:  linux x64
Bound:     16777216 bytes (16 MiB)

  PASS: small body passes through unchanged
  PASS: oversized body truncated to 16777216 bytes
  PASS: Content-Length over cap → 502

============================================================
VERDICT: PASS (3 passed, 0 failed)
============================================================
```

The proof drives the production `buildMcpHttpFetch` pipeline with foreign Response objects (body=null, custom text()) through the undici runtime deps test key — the same code path exercised by the existing `ForeignResponse` test case.

## User Impact

- No more OOM risk from oversized MCP HTTP error/auth response bodies in the `.text()` fallback path
- Transparent for under-cap responses; no config or behavior changes
